verdict.rationale: MX markets a consumer-facing experience where people "ask about their money in plain language and act on the answer" (mx-docs-27). A probe also found an official MCP server documented (mx-probe-3), which suggests an AI assistant could drive the platform conversationally. Neither source shows the product's own operators running MX itself (dashboard, API configuration, webhooks) through natural-language commands, and the MCP evidence is only a pointer with no detail. missing for 10: documented natural-language operation of the platform by its users, details of what the MCP server exposes, hands-on or independent corroboration.
